instruction: I need to get the subtitle content from this video file as a text file. Please extract the subtitles and save them to "subtitles_output.srt".

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting subtitles from video.mp4 and saving as subtitles_output.srt. Evaluator verifies file exists and is non-empty.

llm_judge_reasons: Insufficient verification: Evaluator only checks file existence and non-empty status, not actual subtitle content
False positive vulnerability: Would pass if user creates any non-empty file at target path, even with random/unrelated content
No content validation: Does not verify file contains valid SRT format or subtitle-like content
Semantic mismatch: Instruction requires extracting subtitles FROM video, but evaluator cannot verify extraction occurred or content relates to video
Missing verification of subtitle-specific properties: timestamps, text segments, proper SRT structure
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add content validation to metric: Check for SRT format markers (timestamps like '00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:03,000')
Verify file contains multiple subtitle entries with proper structure (sequence numbers, timestamps, text)
Add minimum/maximum file size checks to ensure reasonable subtitle file (not just 1 byte or empty lines)
Consider verifying presence of expected subtitle content if video subtitles are known/predictable
Add validation that file contains text content (not binary data) and follows SRT conventions
